annotations.text:
Left is the app as it is today, rebuilt from theme.ts, motion.ts and the component stylesheets — not from the screenshots. Right is the proposal.

Red callouts are defects with a measured number behind them. Green callouts are what replaces them.

Two things I did NOT change, both worth a decision:

1. Icons stay text glyphs, per your call. Note the search icon is U+2315 TELEPHONE RECORDER and the chevron is U+2304 — neither is in Roboto, so both fall back to a symbol font. That is what the -5px nudge on the chevron is for.

2. Filenames still render raw (slug + extension). Say the word and cards read 'Machine Learning Yearning' instead.
The four sheets are the clearest single argument for tokens: same job, four row heights, three body sizes, two gutters — none of it decided, all of it drifted.
